$schema_purpose: Defines the JSON shape that the Classifier+Extractor Agent emits per email. Pure description of the email — no routing decisions, no audit findings. The LLM produces exactly this structure. Loaded as a Pydantic model via Instructor at runtime.

field_notes.classification.predicted_category: Must be one of the 7 category names defined in taxonomy.json.
field_notes.classification.sender_type: Must be one of the 5 sender_type values in taxonomy.json.
field_notes.classification.request_type: Must be one of the 10 request_type values in taxonomy.json.
field_notes.classification.booking_lifecycle_stage: Must be one of the 6 lifecycle values in taxonomy.json. Mirrors extraction.booking_identity.notification_type — the LLM should output the same value in both fields.
field_notes.classification.expects_human_response: Must be one of: yes / no / unclear.
field_notes.classification.urgency_signal: Must be one of: routine / urgent / sensitive_complaint.
field_notes.classification.confidence: Float 0-1. Self-reported confidence. Used by the router only as a coarse signal (threshold 0.75).
field_notes.classification.evidence_short: Brief quoted span(s) from the email supporting the classification. Max 200 chars.
field_notes.classification.reasoning_short: One-sentence reasoning for the category choice. Max 200 chars.
field_notes.extraction.booking_identity.notification: Canonical lifecycle field. classification.booking_lifecycle_stage mirrors this.
field_notes.extraction.guest.additional_travelers: List of {name: str|null, age: int|null}. Empty list when no rooming list / only lead guest named.
field_notes.extraction.stay.adults / children: Integers. Leave null if not stated.
field_notes.extraction.stay.child_ages: List of int. Empty list when no children or ages not stated.
field_notes.extraction.financials.tax_breakdown: List of {description: str, amount: float, currency: str|null}. Empty list when no per-component breakdown is shown.
field_notes.extraction.room_and_rate.daily_rate_brea: List of {date: str, rate_id: str|null, price: float|null, currency: str|null, description: str|null}. Empty list otherwise.
field_notes.extraction.requests_and_remarks.raw_rema: Verbatim remarks text. Do NOT interpret. Boilerplate distinction is the audit module's job.

rules: All absent scalar values are JSON null (never the string 'null').
Anonymized tokens (MASKED_NAME_xxx, MASKED_EMAIL_xxx, etc.) are retained verbatim.
Never invent values for fields not present in the email.
total_amount = 0.00 is valid for cancellation notifications — not a missing field.
classification.predicted_intent.belongs_to(classification.predicted_category) — facets are orthogonal but values must come from the enums in taxonomy.json.
